comment: Hand-drawn Polyfusion octave/frequency divider: TL082 input buffer and Schmitt comparator clock a 4024 counter whose seven outputs are level-shifted and filtered by 4136 op-amp sections into Outputs 1-7. No designators drawn.
rows: input and feedback of the first TL082 inverter, reference divider for the comparator, and the input resistor of each of the seven output stages
one into the comparator + input, one pulldown at the 4024 clock input
offset resistor from the negative supply, one per output stage
620 ohm output resistor, one per output
dual op amp: inverting input buffer and comparator
quad op amp, drawn as chips A and B; A drives outputs 1-3 (one section unused), B drives outputs 4-7
